scope: Independent actual-finger contact discretization, separated body/contact fields and reference Newton equivalence

contact_fields.scope: Compare solved Panda spatial refinements at fixed material probes and physical times.
contact_fields.limitations: Fixed polyhedral geometry and physical held points; volume and contact triangles refine together. Fixed material-coordinate interior probes carry seed-volume diagnostic weights, not an exact continuum norm. Tensors use each solution's proper finite body frame; contact wrenches use the shared fixed reference origin. Complete nonlinear global peak lower/upper bounds are retained separately. Two spatial levels or an equal-constructor control do not establish a physical tail. Contact quadrature/regularization/CAD geometry/full-arm support matching and feedback/model/accuracy-cost remain separate required studies.

traction_audit.scope: Audit collision-surface traction quadrature and islands without nodal-load smoothing.
traction_audit.limitations: Densities divide unsmoothed collision-vertex force resultants by current barycentric lumped areas. Support area is a quadrature diagnostic, not an independently resolved physical contact boundary. All source normal/friction forces and island wrenches remain visible. Total contact moment can retain finite-gap friction torque; its regularization error is separate from pullback conservation. No contact/stress tail or full-arm matching is inferred from aggregate force stability.

cached_newton_equivalence.scope: Compare every saved inertial state and every unaveraged corner tensor after a solver change.
cached_newton_equivalence.limitations: Same complete physical inputs and original full mapped/body dynamic force gates; all original field states and unaveraged corner tensors are compared. This qualifies reference numerical equivalence only, not physical convergence, full-arm matching or an accuracy-cost operating range.
